dedupe_keys.name: flood shab cable stayed bridge case study shm monitoring features dataset during the april 2026 hydrometric event

description: The FLOOD-SHAB team publishes structural-health-monitoring features for a cable-stayed bridge across the Saline River in east-central Italy. Zenodo provides CSV data, a dictionary, sensor mapping, a layout image and a public README under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Approximately half-hour records cover 27 March to 10 April 2026, including a hydrometric event. Fields include modal features, acceleration summaries, displacement and cable-load means, weather and an upstream water-level proxy. These data can calibrate bridge response or validate flood-event monitoring workflows. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this bridge release; a round-one FLOOD-SHAB candidate concerns a different synthetic debris dataset. A limitation is that raw acceleration histories are absent, and the water gauge is about three kilometres upstream, not mounted on the bridge. The gauge later failed, so missing values cannot imply low water. No CSV was downloaded or signal analysis repeated.
